notes: Fixed multi-million-file folder freeze, DOC/DOCX signature disambiguation, scan step independence
changelog: Fixed: generating a report from a folder with millions of files (e.g. HFS Time Machine backups) froze the entire app with no feedback — folder counting now runs in the background with a live progress counter

Fixed: DOCX/XLSX/PPTX (and DOC/XLS/PPT) share identical file headers within their format family — signature verification now looks inside the file (ZIP contents or OLE stream names) to correctly tell them apart instead of just matching the header
Fixed: the structural/stream integrity check no longer runs just because Signature verification is enabled — it now depends only on "File content analysis", matching its checkbox
Fixed: scan summary mislabeled structural-check results as "pixel damage" even when pixel analysis never ran — now shown as a separate, correctly labeled line
Fixed: a step could still scan files already moved into another step's destination folder in one case (pixel analysis step)
Swapped the order of "File content analysis" and "Signature verification" in the Scanner tab
